title: Constraint: Sub-Square Maximums
constraints: Split the 4 × 4 matrix into four 2 × 2 quadrants, numbered q = 2·(i/2) + (j/2) (top-left 0, top-right 1, bottom-left 2, bottom-right 3).
The maximum element of quadrant q must be exactly **5 + 3q** (5, 8, 11, 14).
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: Two parts: every element ≤ its quadrant's limit, **and** at least one element equals it.
The quadrant index is `(i / 2) * 2 + j / 2`, and integer division by constants is fine inside constraints.
The "at least one equals" part is an OR over the four cells of each quadrant.

examples.check: the maximum of 2 × 2 quadrant q is 5 + 3q
